meta.parties: Sabaratnam Et Al. v. Indo Lanka Provident Insurance Co

rules.statement: The court held that the attempt to make the liability on a bond depend upon the assignment of another bond was an afterthought and not present at the time of execution.
rules.supporting_quote: "In this state of facts no other conclusion can be reached but that the attempt to make the liability on the bond sued upon depend upon the assignment of the Ramanathan bond is an afterthought and that at the date of the execution of the bond sued upon there was not any agreement or understanding that no obligation was to attach on the bond till the Ramanathan bond was assigned."
